## listRunsForContact

List Flow Runs For Contact. `GET /contacts/{contact_id}/flow-runs`

List flow runs for a specific contact.

Used by the contact-detail "Flows" tab. When status is omitted the response defaults to active runs (running + waiting) — the rows a user expects to see. Pass an explicit status to inspect history.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->listRunsForContact(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

## reorder

Reorder Flows. `PATCH /flows/reorder`

Re-order flow trigger priorities for the current tenant.

Accepts EITHER an ordered flow_ids list (server assigns priority = position, 0-based, so the first id wins) OR an explicit items: [{flow_id, priority}] list. Exactly one shape must be supplied. Lower priority = higher precedence (evaluated first when multiple flows match the same inbound event).

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->reorder();
```

## stopRunByRunId

Stop Flow Run By Run Id. `POST /flows/runs/{run_id}/stop`

Operator-initiated cancel of a flow run, by run_id alone.

Convenience companion to POST /flows/{flow_id}/runs/{run_id}/stop for callers (notably the Conversations UI) that have the run id from the conversation's active_flow_run.run_id but no flow_id. ## deletePermanently

Delete Flow Permanently. `DELETE /flows/{flow_id}/permanent`

Permanently delete a flow — irreversible, destroys run history.

Distinct from DELETE /flows/{id}, which soft-archives (reversible via POST /flows/{id}/unarchive). This endpoint removes the flows row AND every child row: flow_runs, flow_run_steps, flow_run_waits. No FK cascades exist on the flow tables, so the service deletes children explicitly inside one transaction. Keyword-bot wiring that pointed at the flow is detached (set to NULL) rather than deleted. Conversation messages and tracked_links produced by the flow are KEPT — they are real history and their flow attribution readers are already best-effort.

```php
$sendseven->flows()->deletePermanently(flowId: 'flow_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/delete_flow_permanently_api_v1_flows__flow_id__permanent_delete)

| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes | Contact UUID on the tenant's shard |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Optional caller-supplied idempotency key for at-most-once start semantics. If a run with the same (tenant_id, idempotency_key) already exists, the existing run is returned with HTTP 200 instead of creating a new one. If omitted, the engine derives a key from the request payload (e.g. manual:<flow_id>:<contact_id>:<request_id>). |
| `$context` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Extra variables to seed flow_runs.context.vars. Hard-capped at 16 KB JSON-encoded. |
| `$contactMethodOverrides` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Optional map of ChannelType (string value, e.g. email, sms, whatsapp, telegram, messenger, instagram, browser_push) → contact_method.id. When the flow sends on the matching channel, this specific contact_method's value is used as the destination instead of the contact's primary method. Per-channel keys are independent; omitted channels fall back to the default (primary) resolution. Each referenced contact_method must belong to the same tenant, the same contact, and have a method_type that matches the channel key. |
| `$idempotencyKeyIdempotency` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `FlowRun`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/start_flow_run_api_v1_flows__flow_id__runs_post)

## listRunMessages

List Flow Run Messages. `GET /flows/{flow_id}/runs/{run_id}/messages`

List every message attributed to a single flow run, oldest-first.

Returns the chronological transcript of outbound (Send-node) and inbound (Wait-for-reply matched) messages stamped with this flow_run_id. Reuses the existing idx_msg_flow_run_id / idx_messages_tenant_flow_run index.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->listRunMessages(flowId: 'flow_id', runId: 'run_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`, `conversations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$runId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `Page<FlowRunMessage>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/list_flow_run_messages_api_v1_flows__flow_id__runs__run_id__messages_get)

## getRunReplay

Get Run Replay. `GET /flows/{flow_id}/runs/{run_id}/replay`

Per-contact replay timeline for a single flow run.

Merges flow_run_steps (engine audit trail) with messages (outbound + inbound tagged with this flow_run_id) into a single time-ordered event stream. Returns the contact header + the run summary + the full event list.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->getRunReplay(flowId: 'flow_id', runId: 'run_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$runId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `Replay`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/get_run_replay_api_v1_flows__flow_id__runs__run_id__replay_get)

## listRunSteps

List Flow Run Steps. `GET /flows/{flow_id}/runs/{run_id}/steps`

List the audit-trail rows for a single flow run, oldest first.

Each row is enriched from the CURRENT flows.definition: * node_label — editor-visible label (display_name → snapshot label/name → derived). * node_config_snapshot — a curated subset of the node's current config (e.g. for collect_input: validation, max_attempts, on_timeout_node_id, prompt). NOT a point-in-time snapshot of what the engine executed — callers that need that fidelity should rely on input_snapshot. * branch_taken — best-effort from output_snapshot.chosen_branch.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->listRunSteps(flowId: 'flow_id', runId: 'run_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$runId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `Page<FlowRunStep>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/list_flow_run_steps_api_v1_flows__flow_id__runs__run_id__steps_get)

## stopRun

Stop Flow Run. `POST /flows/{flow_id}/runs/{run_id}/stop`

Operator-initiated cancel of a flow run.

Marks the run canceled, deletes pending waits, emits flow.run.canceled webhook. Idempotent — already-terminal runs return their current row unchanged.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->stopRun(flowId: 'flow_id', runId: 'run_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$runId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `FlowRun`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/stop_flow_run_api_v1_flows__flow_id__runs__run_id__stop_post)

## getValidation

Get Flow Validation. `GET /flows/{flow_id}/validation`

Return the publish-time validation snapshot for a flow.

Same shape as FlowResponse.validation — exposed as a dedicated endpoint so the Flows editor can poll cheap validation passes after local edits without re-fetching the whole flow row. The Flows editor uses this to gate the "Activate" button and surface inline {path, message} warnings on the offending nodes / trigger.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->getValidation(flowId: 'flow_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `FlowValidationStatus`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/get_flow_validation_api_v1_flows__flow_id__validation_get)
